entries.title: Luke 17:1
segments: ¶Then He said to the disciples, "It is impossible that no offenses should come, but woe [to him] through whom they do come!

entries.title: Luke 17:2
segments: "It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

entries.title: Luke 17:3
segments: "Take heed to yourselves. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.

entries.title: Luke 17:4
segments: "And if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times in a day returns to you, saying, 'I repent,' you shall forgive him."

entries.title: Luke 17:5
segments: And the apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith."

entries.title: Luke 17:6
segments: So the Lord said, "If you have faith as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, 'Be pulled up by the roots and be planted in the sea,' and it would obey you.

entries.title: Luke 17:7
segments: "And which of you, having a servant plowing or tending sheep, will say to him when he has come in from the field, 'Come at once and sit down to eat'?

entries.title: Luke 17:8
segments: "But will he not rather say to him, 'Prepare something for my supper, and gird yourself and serve me till I have eaten and drunk, and afterward you will eat and drink'?

entries.title: Luke 17:9
segments: "Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I think not.

entries.title: Luke 17:10
segments: "So likewise you, when you have done all those things which you are commanded, say, 'We are unprofitable servants. We have done what was our duty to do.'"

entries.title: Luke 17:11
segments: ¶Now it happened as He went to Jerusalem that He passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

entries.title: Luke 17:12
segments: Then as He entered a certain village, there met Him ten men who were lepers, who stood afar off.

entries.title: Luke 17:13
segments: And they lifted up [their] voices and said, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!"

entries.title: Luke 17:14
segments: So when He saw [them], He said to them, "Go, show yourselves to the priests." And so it was that as they went, they were cleansed.

entries.title: Luke 17:15
segments: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, returned, and with a loud voice glorified God,

entries.title: Luke 17:16
segments: and fell down on [his] face at His feet, giving Him thanks. And he was a Samaritan.

entries.title: Luke 17:17
segments: So Jesus answered and said, "Were there not ten cleansed? But where [are] the nine?

entries.title: Luke 17:18
segments: "Were there not any found who returned to give glory to God except this foreigner?"

entries.title: Luke 17:19
segments: And He said to him, "Arise, go your way. Your faith has made you well."

entries.title: Luke 17:20
segments: ¶Now when He was asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, He answered them and said, "The kingdom of God does not come with observation;

entries.title: Luke 17:21
segments: "nor will they say, 'See here!' or 'See there!' For indeed, the kingdom of God is within you."

entries.title: Luke 17:22
segments: Then He said to the disciples, "The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see [it].

entries.title: Luke 17:23
segments: "And they will say to you, 'Look here!' or 'Look there!' Do not go after [them] or follow [them].

entries.title: Luke 17:24
segments: "For as the lightning that flashes out of one [part] under heaven shines to the other [part] under heaven, so also the Son of Man will be in His day.

entries.title: Luke 17:25
segments: "But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

entries.title: Luke 17:26
segments: "And as it was in the days of Noah, so it will be also in the days of the Son of Man:

entries.title: Luke 17:27
segments: "They ate, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

entries.title: Luke 17:28
segments: "Likewise as it was also in the days of Lot: They ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

entries.title: Luke 17:29
segments: "but on the day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven and destroyed [them] all.

entries.title: Luke 17:30
segments: "Even so will it be in the day when the Son of Man is revealed.

entries.title: Luke 17:31
segments: "In that day, he who is on the housetop, and his goods [are] in the house, let him not come down to take them away. And likewise the one who is in the field, let him not turn back.

entries.title: Luke 17:32
segments: "Remember Lot's wife.

entries.title: Luke 17:33
segments: "Whoever seeks to save his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life will preserve it.

entries.title: Luke 17:34
segments: "I tell you, in that night there will be two [men] in one bed: the one will be taken and the other will be left.

entries.title: Luke 17:35
segments: "Two [women] will be grinding together: the one will be taken and the other left.

entries.title: Luke 17:36
segments: "Two [men] will be in the field: the one will be taken and the other left."

entries.title: Luke 17:37
segments: And they answered and said to Him, "Where, Lord?" So He said to them, "Wherever the body is, there the eagles will be gathered together."
